description: List corridors and each route's standing: proven (a real price and at least one closed landing), priced_only, or no_live_route with a reason. Includes last_priced_at, last_landed_at, landed_count and max_age_seconds. A route is never proven without a closed landing. Free callers see masked route names. Same records as GET /api/v1/coverage?view=routes.

access_key.description: A router key (rk_...), if not sent as a Bearer header.

name: get_coverage
title: Route standing for every corridor
